statements.impact_statement: The image replaces Debian's SQLite 3.46.1 with the official SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation, verified against the published SHA3-256. Upstream fixed the FTS5 doclist merge overflow in 3.54.0. verify_sqlite.py checks the loaded version and exercises negative-rowid detail=none prefix queries in the final image. This version is packaged locally; Debian has not recorded a fixed distribution version yet.

This vulnerability is in the SQLite CLI .recover dot-command. build-sqlite.sh compiles only sqlite3.c into a shared library; shell.c is not compiled or installed. The final distroless image contains no SQLite CLI, and verify_sqlite.py checks the executable locations. The Python sqlite3 module and FTS5 remain available.
